# Delivery and Checks

- Task ID (`T<NNN>`), Issue, manager / worker session, target branch:
- Status change to record in `docs/work/plan/plan.yaml` (for example `T003: active -> review`), or none:
- Change scope and acceptance criteria:
- Test commands, actual results, unverified scope:
- Run IDs, code SHA, data version, artifact location:
- Contract and compatibility impact (sections of `docs/research/contracts.md`):

## Manager review

- [ ] Base, reviewed head SHA and diff scope confirmed.
- [ ] Tests pass on the current combination; experiment evidence supports the claims in this PR.
- [ ] Required re-review done after any base or head update.
- [ ] If `AGENTS.md` changed, `AGENTS.zh-CN.md` is updated.
